title: FANS-free nuclei isolation from green plant tissues for single nucleus RNA-seq and ATAC-seq
author: Lee J. Conneely
materials: Count nuclei and assess nuclei integrity by microscopy.

steps.title: Weigh tissue
steps.instruction: Weigh 180 mg fresh green tissue and place it into a small plastic Petri dish on ice.

steps.title: Chop tissue on ice
steps.instruction: Chop the tissue on ice for a maximum of 2 min using a new razor blade (e.g., Feather platinum‑coated double‑edge) to obtain a slurry‑like consistency; avoid over‑chopping.

steps.title: Add wash buffer and incubate
steps.instruction: Add an additional 350 µL Wash Buffer, incubate the lysate on ice for 2 min and gently agitate the Petri dish to distribute the chopped material evenly.

steps.title: Add RNase inhibitor
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL Wash Buffer containing 1 U/µL Protector RNase Inhibitor to the mixture.

steps.title: Collect lysate
steps.instruction: Tilt the Petri dish to approximately 45° and collect the liquid lysate using a wide‑bore P1000 pipette tip.

steps.title: Filter lysate
steps.instruction: Filter the lysate through a pre‑wetted 20 µm mini PluriStrainer into a fresh 2 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Aspirate supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully aspirate 500 µL supernatant with a P1000 pipette, taking care not to disturb the loosely packed debris pellet.

steps.title: Low‑speed spin for debris
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filtrate at 50 × g for 3 min at 4 °C using a swinging‑bucket rotor to pellet large debris (e.g., non‑glandular trichomes).

steps.title: Collect nuclei band
steps.instruction: Carefully aspirate 200 µL from the green band at the interface between the Wash Buffer and the 30 % Percoll layer using a P200 fitted with a wide‑bore tip; avoid disturbing the lower green band at the 30 %/70 % interphase.

steps.title: Underlay 30 % Percoll
steps.instruction: Using a P200 pipette, carefully underlay 200 µL 30 % Percoll beneath the filtered nuclei suspension.

steps.title: Add lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL Lysis Buffer to the collected nuclei fraction.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Two additional washes
steps.instruction: Repeat the following twice: add 1 mL Wash Buffer (without Triton X‑100), centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, then carefully remove the supernatant without disturbing the nuclei pellet.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL Wash Buffer (no Triton X‑100).

steps.title: Resuspend nuclei pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the nuclei pellet in 50 µL Diluted Nuclei Buffer by gently pipetting 5 times.

steps.title: High‑speed spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 2,500 × g for 15 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Underlay 70 % Percoll
steps.instruction: Carefully underlay 200 µL 70 % Percoll beneath the existing 30 % Percoll layer.

steps.title: Second low‑speed spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet post‑gradient
steps.instruction: If the pellet is translucent, resuspend in 1 mL Wash Buffer; if the pellet is green, resuspend in 1 mL Wash Buffer containing 0.2 % Triton X‑100. Mix gently by pipetting 5 times.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully remove the supernatant without disturbing the nuclei pellet.

steps.title: Incubate on ice
steps.instruction: Mix by gently inverting the tube and incubate on ice for 5 min, inverting once every minute.

steps.title: Strain through cell strainer
steps.instruction: Pass the suspension through a pre‑wetted 20 µm cell strainer using Lysis Buffer.

steps.title: Aliquot nuclei for tagmentation
steps.instruction: Immediately transfer 20 µL nuclei suspension to a new RNase‑free, low‑bind tube; keep on ice and do not stain with DNA‑binding dyes.

steps.title: Load nuclei onto haemocytometer
steps.instruction: Load 10 µL stained nuclei suspension onto a haemocytometer.

steps.title: Stain nuclei with Hoechst
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL Hoechst 33342 (50 µg/mL) to the stained suspension and gently mix by pipetting 5 times with a P20 pipette.

steps.title: Prepare microscopy sample
steps.instruction: Transfer 20 µL of the remaining nuclei suspension to a separate tube for microscopy.

steps.title: Assess nuclei quality
steps.instruction: If nuclei yield, integrity, and cleanliness are acceptable, proceed immediately to the 10x Genomics protocol for nuclei dilution (if required) and tagmentation.

steps.title: Count and evaluate nuclei
steps.instruction: Load 10 µL stained nuclei suspension onto a haemocytometer, count nuclei and assess integrity, debris, and clumping by microscopy. If large clumps (>5 nuclei per aggregate) dominate, adjust experimental parameters or pass the suspension through a 10 µm or 20 µm cell strainer and reassess. Aim for >70 % nuclei with intact membranes and minimal clumping.
